data_fields.name: liveTurnsCap
data_fields.donor_constant: min(10, elapsed / 10) live turns on re-entry

data_fields.name: turnElapsedTotal
data_fields.donor_constant: (live + quick) * 10 ticks reported to the bus (donor is short by live * 10; fixed in sketch)

best_idea: After a zone sits empty, simulate at most a capped number of live turns, then advance the cheap timers by the uncapped remainder, so a long absence costs bounded work and nothing is counted twice.
decision_why: Keep the capped live catch-up and the cheap remainder timers; fix the donor's double subtraction, make the cap zone data, and award no kills or loot during catch-up, since the donor's live part moves monsters and the rules here are server-verified kills and one ledger.
acceptance: A server test leaves a zone empty for 300 ticks, re-enters it, and asserts 10 live spawn steps, timers advanced by 200 ticks, and a timer total of 300; a 50-tick absence gives 5 live and 0 quick steps; no kill or loot credit is recorded during catch-up.
